description: Add an external web domain running an agent node (DRP v1.0 / MCP) to the shared peer table so other agents can reach it.

agent_api_key.description: Your kf_ext_... or kf_core_... API key obtained from kinform_register_agent.

domain.description: Domain name to peer into the decentralized directory (e.g. agentnode.org).

manifestUrl.description: Public URL to /.well-known/drp.json or /server.json on that domain.

mcpEndpoint.description: Public Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint URL on that domain.

name: kinform_register_node
